note: The properties registry: the declaration table of docs/registries.md, binding scope x property to its one authoritative registry. Registries name their carrier, key field (structural identity, exempt from declaration), target grain, scope, gate, and whether their per-row fields are `governed` (held to the declarations below) or `ungoverned` (declared and counted, with a written `why` naming what about the carrier the field check cannot reach). Declarations carry mode (recorded or computed, with the deriver for computed), required (what the gates enforce today: value, counted, or none), and the value domain where one is closed. Governed carriers are held both ways by tools/test/properties-registry.test.mjs: an undeclared row field fails, a declared property missing from the carrier fails, a value outside a declared closed domain fails (431 values across eight domains; added 2026-08-09, when filling budget-drs's definition_owner field turned up that eight domains were declared and none were read), a computed declaration whose deriver does not exist fails, and the ungoverned count is asserted so it can only move deliberately. Expanded 2026-08-09 from six registries to thirteen by the reconciliation recorded in docs/registries.md, which walked the estate against the model rather than the model against itself. Ten are field-governed and three are not; the pages catalog moved from the second group to the first the same day, by teaching the field check a group walk rather than by reshaping a carrier other repos read. Origin: budget-drs data/design/properties.csv in mehrlander/home.

registries.scope: every .md and .json file under docs/ (the gate walks those two extensions; docs/examples/, docs/prototypes/ and docs/favicons/ hold four other files, out of scope and deliberately so)
every .mjs under tools/test/ except the declared shared helpers
code files under tools/ and scripts/, except tools/test/, which the tests census owns
artifacts the registry curates; authoritative for what it covers, undeclared is a normal state
registries.target: an artifact, by locator (may refine below a file)

registries.scope: what the hub ships to other repos
utility pages curated into show-repo's Tools view

registries.target: a repeated statement, or a scope for a family rule
registries.scope: statements the hub's coordination layer repeats; curated against the written scope in the carrier, not complete over the estate
every .html page under pages/, arranged into groups; the group wrapper (label, top) is structure rather than assertions about a page, the same standing as a carrier note block

registries.target: a route, a delivery mode, or a showing mechanism
registries.scope: how content moves, renders, and gets looked at
registries.why: four sibling blocks (grammar, modes, routes, showing) with different row shapes, not one population; splitting it into four registries would declare four scopes nobody uses separately

registries.scope: the primitives SURFACING.md defines; the PROSE is authoritative and this is its gated index, so ownership runs opposite to every other registry here
registries.why: an index of prose rather than a table of assertions: membership is held two-way against the document, and the summaries carry no properties to declare

registries.scope: every key in use across the estate's repo manifests
registries.why: the target is a manifest KEY, not a file, and the carrier describes the key rather than asserting properties of rows; the field check has no row array to read

declarations.gloss: what the document is about, one line
whether the document is kept true, preserved as written, or derived from measurement
who can get to the document: injected at session start, reachable from project instructions, a skill, the app, or nothing
the document's size, and its share of the folder
who keeps the document true; a bare row is counted by the census rather than hidden
the genre of check; the vocabulary is closed and the gate holds rows to it
the one thing that breaks if the test is deleted; blanks are counted
top-level test() calls; null for a browser check, whose unit test() is not

what each top-level test() call is named, in source order; the file's own account of its coverage, so protects need not restate it. A parameterized name is carried as its template text. Null for a browser check, alongside its null count
how the check reaches its subject, strongest present wins
suite for a *.test.mjs file, else the npm script that runs it, else unrun
which assertions only check a component mounts, as indices into assertion_names; the property is per assertion, so a file-level count is the length rather than the record. Null for a browser check
what the file is for; blanks are counted rather than hidden
the file's folder, the rail's tree
file length
how the file gets run: npm:<script>, driver, imported, argv, or none found (the warning state)
writes a file: a generator rather than a reader
its path or basename appears in tracked prose
a file under tools/test/ exercises it
what the artifact IS epistemically; the portable content-registry skill owns the convention
what the artifact is good for downstream. The domain is closed and is owned by the content-registry skill, not here; docs/owners.json records the copy
one line on the artifact
what species of thing travels
the invocation name; present on kind:skill rows only
display name
what the item does for an adopting repo
when to reach for it
card title
one line under the card title
phosphor icon name
whether the row owns one repeated statement or declares a rule over a scope; a family row is a DECLARATION in this model, carried here because its carrier is distributed
the population a family rule covers; absent on a statement row
the one carrier that owns the statement; every other mention is a repetition
each other place the statement appears, with its relation (copy, paraphrase, pointer, live read), who keeps a copy, and the check that holds it or the honest absence of one
the skill's trigger description. A COPY: the authoritative carrier is the skill's own SKILL.md, per the family rule in docs/owners.json
the short name the catalog card and the picker show
the page's own <title>, read from the file
the one-line blurb. Authored in the NOTES map inside the deriver, not here, and blank on 42 of 69 pages: a counted figure, the honest measure of how much of the gallery is unexplained
the committed screenshot path; refreshed once per session, never by the commit hook
the GitHub blob URL for the page source
the task's short imperative, read from its frontmatter
where the task sits. Domain owned by docs/TRACKER.md
the date the task was filed
the date it was completed; absent while open, which is not a blank to count
the task file this row is derived from
the blob URL the board and the caption link to
the date of the newest progress-log line
how many progress-log lines the task carries
the branch that owns the task while it is in progress, or completed it
the workspace a task belongs to, where the repo scopes them
effort calibrated to the session. Domain owned by docs/TRACKER.md; optional by design, and carried on 9 of 75
the dependency or workstream tag, including depends-on: pointers
open tags preserved from the frontmatter and not acted on
free text naming what is holding the task; cleared by hand
the task or condition a blocked row names
